fact: The Instituto Nacional de Estatistica released its fifth Estatisticas Vitais report on 1 October 2025, covering 2023 (6,760 births, 2,925 deaths, 2,435 marriages), compiled from administrative records of the Registos, Notariado e Identificacao.
INE released the Estatisticas Vitais 2023 report on 1 October 2025, built on civil register administrative records and covering 2016-2023.

On 14-16 April 2025, with WHO support and Portuguese Cooperation funding, Cabo Verde assessed its death certification and cause-of-death notification process and trained health professionals as trainers, to improve the quality of vital statistics.
system: Death certification and cause-of-death notification process

fact: The profile states that the collaboration protocol between INE and the civil registry service was updated in 2014 and a cooperation protocol signed with the Directorate of Registries, Notaries and Identification to transmit birth data to INE; no signing date is given for the latter, profile compiled December 2016 to November 2017.

COOPSTAT News reports that the coordinator of Cabo Verde's ADA/Master Data project made a working visit to Statistics Portugal on 10-11 September 2024 on modernisation and use of administrative data for statistical purposes.
Open Data Watch's ODIN (2024 round) lists the national statistics office's statistical yearbook as publishing numbers of schools and teaching staff, latest data year 2021.

The Ministry of Health of Cabo Verde issued its Relatorio Estatistico 2022 (Praia, July 2024), a statistical report for 2022; the passages give its title and date only, so as_of is the report's July 2024 imprint.
